integrity: The lower bound is an exhaustive finite check of every crossing-exchange parameter triple for one word together with direct symmetry and deletion checks; the upper bound is an explicit four-move sequence to the known five-petal trefoil. No finite experiment is used to claim a broader infinite theorem.
limitations: The theorem concerns one explicit seven-petal trefoil word and the move set \(\mathsf T^{\pm},\mathsf X,\mathsf R,\mathsf S\). It does not classify all trefoil representatives or other knots, and a later revision or unindexed independent note could contain the same example.
title: A seven-petal trefoil requires a nine-petal detour
